title: Cusp restrictions and Bunke--Naumann invariants with level structure
summary: Restriction to the full cusp divisor of a modular curve defines a secondary invariant whose rational indeterminacy comes from a single global modular form. For every integral weakly holomorphic level-one modular form $h$ of weight divisible by four, we prove that the imported value $[h/2]$ vanishes at every nontrivial $Γ_0(N)$ level. The construction localizes coefficients before completion and rationalizes only after passing to homotopy groups.
